ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 5% high-intensity (white/grey) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in localized circular clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary solid black field across both lobes. Distal tips (left and right) exhibit contiguous white-to-grey pixel mapping with irregular borders. Multiple high-contrast circular spots (diameter 10-20 pixels) are distributed across the mid-section of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at approximately 55 degrees, with a depth approximately 1/8th of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Medial trailing edge shows low-frequency, low-amplitude oscillations. Distal sections near the tips exhibit high-frequency, jagged pixel-amplitude variations due to external texture/encrustation.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge from the median notch to the distal tips; leading edge shows a smooth convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left mid-lobe contains a cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white circular pixel groups. Right mid-lobe contains 3 distinct, smaller circular markers.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Right distal lobe features a series of approximately 7 parallel, vertical-to-diagonal high-contrast linear disruptions (rake marks) breaking the black pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive high-contrast, textured calcified clusters on the far distal margins of both lobes; linear rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant cluster of textured, high-relief pixel formations at the extreme outer edges of both lobes, protruding from the geometric boundary of the fluke.
